title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 24: One Mic

scenes.say: The biggest stage yet. A full arena of young people.
scenes.visual: an arena full of people, stage lights sweeping, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Backstage, he holds Roddy's dog tags.
scenes.visual: dog tags held in a closed fist under a backstage light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He walks out to one mic and one spotlight.
scenes.visual: a single microphone stand under a spotlight on a big stage, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Seventeen years old. Two choices. Prison or the Army.
scenes.visual: a projected image of an empty courtroom on an arena screen, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He tells it all. The block. The blast. The cancer. The comeback.
scenes.visual: a speaker on stage seen from behind, crowd lit in blue, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: You can hear a pin drop in a room of ten thousand.
scenes.visual: a silent crowd in a dark arena, faces lit softly, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Your past is not your prison, he tells them.
scenes.visual: a speaker raising one hand on a bright stage, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
the crowd rising to its feet, arms in the air, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Phones light up the whole arena like stars.
scenes.visual: thousands of phone lights glowing in a dark arena, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: One mic. One message. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a microphone set down on a stage, spotlight fading, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for the final episode. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: an empty stage with lights powering down, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 24 of 25: One Mic. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
